scope: Targeted property tests extending Topological Simplex Normal Form (TSNF) to 3-complexes with tetrahedra, Stokes boundary nilpotency (d1.d2 = 0, d2.d3 = 0), and Euler-Poincare invariance on 3-sphere S^3 and 3-ball B^3 triangulations

properties_verified.details: Verified exact equality chi_cells == chi_homology (|C_0| - |C_1| + |C_2| - |C_3| == b0 - b1 + b2 - b3) across 100 random simplicial 3-complexes with 4 to 8 vertices, arbitrary tetrahedra counts, and valid face orientations.
Verified 0-th Betti number b0 strictly equals the count of connected components derived from an independent BFS graph traversal oracle across all 100 3-complex trials.
Verified 3-sphere S^3 (chi=0, b0=1, b1=0, b2=0, b3=1 on minimal 4-simplex boundary) and solid 3-ball B^3 (chi=1, b0=1, b1=0, b2=0, b3=0 on single and compound triangulations).
Verified that d2 . d3 == 0 identically over Z for arbitrary oriented 3-simplices.
Verified that non-canonical vertex orderings, duplicate tetrahedron declarations, and omitted boundary 2-faces fail closed with Reject and descriptive defect diagnostics.
